title: Photography
slide_intent: Mark the switch from written and typographic rules to image selection, giving the reader a clear chapter boundary.
strategic_value: The repeated green divider can connect the photography chapter to the other parts of the museum identity.
demonstration: The full page uses a dark green field, a small 6.0 section label and a white Photography heading.
practical_value: Use the divider to locate image direction, collection reproductions and credit guidance.
